name: Trafford

neighbourhoods.name: Altrincham
neighbourhoods.housing: Victorian and Edwardian terraces and villas near the town centre, flats and large detached houses in Bowdon and Hale.

neighbourhoods.name: Sale

neighbourhoods.name: Stretford
neighbourhoods.housing: Inter-war and post-war semis and terraces, with flats near the Mall and Old Trafford.

neighbourhoods.name: Old Trafford and Gorse Hill
neighbourhoods.housing: Dense Victorian terraced streets, many privately let, and newer flats near the stadiums.

neighbourhoods.name: Urmston and Flixton
neighbourhoods.housing: Edwardian and inter-war semis and terraces popular with families.

neighbourhoods.name: Hale and Bowdon
neighbourhoods.housing: Large Victorian villas and detached houses on wide tree-lined roads.

neighbourhoods.name: Timperley

neighbourhoods.name: Partington and Carrington

housing: Trafford has the highest average house price in the North West, driven by Altrincham, Hale and Bowdon, and has some of Greater Manchester's most sought-after school catchments. Private renting is below the regional average and concentrated in Old Trafford, Stretford and Sale, close to the Metrolink into Manchester. Housing ranges from dense Victorian terraces in Old Trafford to large villas in Bowdon and post-war estates in Partington. New apartment blocks are going up around Stretford and Sale.
checkinTips: Victorian terraces in Old Trafford and Gorse Hill: photograph back yards, rear walls and any damp low on the walls.
Large villas in Hale and Bowdon: record gardens, gates, garages, alarm panels and codes, and any period features such as fireplaces.
Apartments near Metrolink stops in Sale and Stretford: note fob and key counts, parking permits, bin store access and the intercom handset.
Family semis in Urmston and Timperley: photograph gardens, fences, sheds and garage doors as lets often include them.
Homes near the Mersey and the Bridgewater Canal: check ground floors and walls for damp or past flood marks.
tenantHelp: Private tenants can contact Trafford Council's Housing Standards Team about disrepair, damp or unsafe conditions, or report a potentially unlicensed HMO online.
